Package com.irurueta.authserver.bff.api.web.login

Class BffLoginExceptionHandler

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.bff.api.web.login.BffLoginExceptionHandler
@RestControllerAdvice(assignableTypes=BffLoginController.class) public class BffLoginExceptionHandler extends Object
Answers a login request whose parameters break the constraints of the contract (returnTo too long, acrValues of the wrong format, maxAge out of range) with 400, as the contract declares: the validation of the generated interface throws a ConstraintViolationException, which would otherwise be a 500. Like the other 400 of the login, the answer has no body.
